content: पिष्ट {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [पिष-क्त] .²1 Ground, powdered, crushed; यत् पिषतामपि नॄणां पिष्टोऽपि तनोषि परिमलैः पुष्टिम् <ls>Bv. 1. 12</ls>. .²2 Rubbed together, squeezed or clasped (as the hands). .²3 Kneaded. .{@-ष्टम्@} .²1 Anything ground, a ground substance. .²2 Flour, meal; पिष्टं पिनष्टि he ‘grinds flour’; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} does a useless work or a profitless repetition. .²3 Lead.
